rationale: This is a mechanical stacking of three already-evaluated archive winners with a pre-announced expected result rather than a new economic idea, and it is internally inconsistent in its central claim of independent gates: on the reconstructed branch, ib − oancf_recon + dp is algebraically identical to the balance-sheet working-capital accrual and the cash gate uses the same reconstruction, so the "separately auditable" conditions collapse into rearrangements of the same line items for a third of the sample.

Adding the already-tested chronic-accrual gate to the already-tested equity-scaled cash-gated signal is a one-ingredient cosmetic increment whose two parents both sit near alpha 6.9%/t≈4.2, and the claimed cure for the ABS(ceq) distress contaminant is asserted rather than measured (a negative-equity biotech with positive pre-R&D cash flow and low accruals passes all three gates).

This swaps the asset-scaled denominator for an equity-scaled one in the long leg of an already-evaluated two-corner spread (alpha 7.0%, t=4.97) whose two scalings the proposal itself concedes delivered nearly identical standalone results, so the expected information gain is close to zero and any small improvement would be indistinguishable from selection noise.

This is a genuine and well-posed diagnostic — the existing best short leg does double-count the low-cash-flow condition through both ib − oancf and oancf + xrd, and replacing the wedge with the noncash balance-sheet accrual makes the three screens economically independent — though the reviewer should note the result is only informative if the short leg's alpha is compared against the double-counting version on the identical sample.

A clean, properly motivated one-factor ablation that separates the depreciation adjustment from the coverage extension, which the archive confounded; the caveat is that it is attribution rather than discovery, so it should be judged on whether it changes the recommended specification, not on headline alpha.

Taking MIN of two near-mechanically-collinear measures of the same construct (TS_SUM(xrd,5)/at and TS_SUM(xrd,5)/(|ceq|+TS_SUM(xrd,5)) share the same numerator and produced near-identical standalone stats) is a trivial variant that will mostly just tighten the long leg's breadth, and any gain will be confounded with the reduction in portfolio count rather than attributable to the claimed "unambiguously intangible-intensive" refinement.
